trials.title: A Study to Evaluate ARV-806 in Adults With Advanced Cancer That Has the KRAS G12D Mutation

primaryOutcomes.measure: Part A (Phase 1): Number of dose-limiting toxicities (DLTs) of ARV-806
Part A (Phase 1): Number of participants with AEs
Part B (Phase 2): Overall Response Rate (ORR)

reasons: one of only 3 trials at this company

signals.text: Primary completion pulled forward 12 months vs original registration (Jun 2025): Nov 2027 to Nov 2026
signals.read: Enrollment ran ahead of plan. Generally a demand and execution positive.
Closed well short of plan. Either enrollment stalled or the sponsor cut the study; powering may be compromised.

trials.commentary: Ph 1/Ph 2, open-label. Enrolled 76 vs 159 at registration (-52%). Started May 2025, primary completion Nov 2026 vs Nov 2027 at registration (-12 mo, 1 moves); planned 2.5 yrs, now 1.5 yrs. Recruiting opened Jun 2025, enrollment closed Jun 2026 (13 mo recruiting). Enrollment has been closed 4 months; the next event is data.
